note: Rewritten from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source describes the soldier and the alate (the alate after Akhtar 1976). One figure, the pronotal length of the soldier, is omitted because of OCR damage (0.29..0.301). Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been deleted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and labrum yellowish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; pronotum yellow; body pale. Head sparsely pilose, pronotum slightly more pilose. Head subrectangular; length to mandibular base 1.13–1.25 mm, maximum width 0.88–0.96 mm. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Labrum subsquare, anterior margin narrowly rounded. Mandibles long, apex weakly incurved; almost as long as the head (length 1.13–1.21 mm, left mandible length/head length ratio 0.90–0.91); finely serrate. Postmentum slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.88–0.96 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.33 mm); waist weakly incurved (waist width/maximum width ratio 0.70–0.75). Pronotum saddle-shaped, width 0.55–0.59 mm; anterior and posterior margins both weakly concave.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum dark brown, with a smoky tinge; antennae dark brown; postclypeus slightly paler than the head; abdominal tergites dark reddish brown, slightly paler than the pronotum and the head. Head and body densely covered with short setae and scattered long setae; pronotum slightly more pilose than the head. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly parallel; length to mandibular base 0.88–0.96 mm, width including the compound eyes 0.92–1.03 mm; V-shaped suture faintly visible. Frontal plate small, circular. Compound eyes round-oval; major diameter 0.23–0.25 mm, minor diameter 0.20–0.22 mm; lower margin slightly more than half its major diameter from the lower margin of the head (0.12–0.14 mm), not prominent. Ocelli small, subcircular; long diameter 0.06–0.10 mm, short diameter 0.06–0.08 mm; separated from the compound eye by their diameter, 0.06–0.08 mm. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 twice as long as segment 3, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus convex, pilose; distinctly longer than half its width (length 0.24–0.26 mm, width 0.43–0.47 mm). Pronotum subsemicircular; length 0.49–0.53 mm, width 0.78–0.85 mm; anterior margin nearly straight, without a notch; posterior margin rounded, slightly concave medially.
